title: Morrow Insights Exchange: integrated audit v1
precedence: October 7 scholarly and conceptual audit controls status; July reparative phenomenology and June nine-spine audits inform tests but do not restore backburnered theories.

coverage.C3: high prior project coverage, never entire oeuvre

gates.question: Exact source, edition, access, claim, and bibliographic verification
Concept origin: borrowed, adapted, coined, extended, unresolved, restricted or superseded
Concrete scene, historical institutions, mechanism, context and appropriate evidence class
Reciprocity: outside scholarship can correct or reject the Negromantic extension
Genre, body, form, performance, affect and mediation where applicable
Opacity: classify uncertainty; protect consent, archival absence and authorship
Bearing: who pays, works, risks and benefits; distinguish conversion from real repair
Independent audit: objections, replicability, operator conflicts and versioned correction

evidence_rule: Use evidence appropriate to the claim; experience does not alone prove causality, ritual accounts do not alone establish spirit as an external entity, fictional work is not archival evidence, policy success needs measured outcomes.
failures: Analogy treated as established causal genealogy
Reviewer controlled by same operator counted independent
A transferred cost described as repaired
promotion: Proposed remains proposed until source, concept, reciprocal test and independent checks explicitly pass. Publish negative outcomes, dissent and scope limits.
private_sources: No private Negromancy manuscripts or confidential collaborator data published.
